description: This file defines the 'WithSender' interface used for pairing a message with its sender in an Akka-based control flow. It provides methods to retrieve the message and sender, as well as a static factory method to create such pairs.

classes.name: WithSender
classes.description: A generic interface representing a message bundled with its sender, providing accessors and a static factory method.

methods.name: getMessage
methods.description: Returns the message of type T, which extends WithDittoHeaders.

methods.name: getSender
methods.description: Returns the sender as an ActorRef.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Creates a new WithSender instance with the specified message.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Static factory method to create a WithSender instance bundling a message and its sender.
